meta.title: BioSense — Next-Generation Biosensing Technology
meta.description: BioSense is developing a multi-parameter biosensing platform exploring glucose, tissue oxygen and temperature sensing.
meta.ogDescription: A multi-parameter biosensing platform in research and development. Not a medical device.

hero.body: A multi-parameter biosensing platform in development, exploring a more continuous view of human biology.
hero.disclaimer: BioSense is experimental and in development. It is not currently an approved medical device and is not intended for diagnosis or treatment.

overview.title: A sensor. A band. Software that finds meaning.
overview.body: BioSense is developing a multi-parameter biosensing platform built around three connected elements: a small sensing module, an external BioBand wearable, and software designed to turn biological signals into understandable context.

sensor.label: BioSense Sensor
sensor.body: A compact sensing module under development.

band.label: BioBand
band.body: An external wearable designed to communicate with the sensor and connect the system to the phone.

app.label: App
app.body: Software designed to turn signals into trends and context.

glucose.title: Glucose
glucose.body: BioSense is exploring continuous glucose-related sensing in interstitial fluid.

oxygen.title: Tissue oxygen
oxygen.body: An experimental sensing channel is being researched to study local tissue oxygen-related signals.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.body: A local temperature channel is being developed to provide additional biological context.

why.title: Your body is always changing.
why.body: BioSense is being developed around the idea that trends and context may be more useful than isolated measurements.

patterns.title: Understand patterns
patterns.body: See how the body moves through ordinary days — not just a single reading.

change.title: See change over time
change.body: Follow shifts across hours, days and weeks instead of isolated snapshots.

context.title: Build personal context
context.body: Connect signals to meals, rest, movement and recovery — the life around the numbers.

sensor.label: Sensor
sensor.body: A compact sensing module under development.

insight.label: Insight
insight.body: The long-term aim is meaning — not a stream of unexplained numbers.

development.title: Engineering before promises.
development.body: BioSense is being built step by step. We are developing the platform carefully before making claims about what it can do.
development.disclaimer: BioSense is experimental. BioSense is in development. BioSense is not currently an approved medical device. It is not intended for diagnosis or treatment. Concepts shown on this website may change.
development.responsible: Implantable biosensing requires rigorous work in materials, long-term stability, biological compatibility, validation and regulatory development.

vision.title: Technology should help people understand themselves.
vision.line: Give people a clearer relationship with their own biology.
vision.not3: Not another screen full of meaningless numbers.

what.a: BioSense is a research and development project exploring a future multi-parameter biosensing platform combining a small sensing module, an external wearable and software.

available.a: No. BioSense is currently under development and is not commercially available.

device.a: No. BioSense is not currently an approved medical device and is not intended for diagnosis or treatment.

measure.q: What is BioSense designed to measure?
measure.a: Current research explores glucose-related sensing, an experimental tissue-oxygen channel and local temperature.

battery.q: Does the sensing module contain a battery?
battery.a: The current concept is designed without a conventional rechargeable battery inside the sensing module. Final architecture may evolve during development.

spo2.q: Does BioSense measure blood oxygen or SpO₂?
spo2.a: No. The current oxygen research channel is experimental and should not be interpreted as pulse-oximeter SpO₂.

stage.a: BioSense is in research and engineering. Bench validation and physical prototypes are next. Clinical and regulatory work remains further ahead.

collaborate.a: Yes. BioSense welcomes serious conversations with researchers, engineers, laboratories, manufacturers and strategic technology partners.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body:
This page describes how BioSense handles information submitted through the public website.

If you join the update list, we collect the first name, email, interest type and consent you submit, only to send project updates or reply to that request.

We do not sell this information. We do not use it for medical advice.

If analytics are enabled later, that will be disclosed here. By default, this site does not load third-party trackers.

Write to hello@biosense.dev to request deletion of your details.
